people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said to him, “Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;
translations.bsb: The captain of the guard found Jeremiah and said to him, “The LORD your God decreed this disaster on this place,
translations.kjv: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.
translations.asv: And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, Jehovah thy God pronounced this evil upon this place;
